answer: Each agent posts a 50 POA deposit in custody, locked like basalt for 20 epochs, every referral on a public graph. A flagged cluster gets a visible pigment dye, exposing the shared funder, and any peer may dispute a suspect: if it holds, deposit and referrer are slashed. Forging 100 identities locks 5,000 POA and invites slashing, while an honest agent pays once, keeps its deposit, and grows layer by layer like a pearl, rewards never diluted.
